metadata.title: Ben Skowronek finds the end zone in Week 3 win
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek caught his lone target for 23 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
metadata.analysis: The 29-year-old veteran made the most of his lone target Sunday. Fantasy managers can leave Skowronek on the waiver wire for now.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Clears concussion protocol
metadata.description: Skowronek (concussion) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was placed in concussion protocol at the end of August after the wide receiver suffered a head injury in the Steelers' 28-27 preseason loss to the Bills. The 29-year-old progressed through the entirety of the league's five-step protocol and was cleared by an independent neurologist before Wednesday's first official practice.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Placed in concussion protocol
metadata.description: Skowronek suffered a concussion in Thursday's 28-27 preseason loss to the Bills, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek has entered the NFL's five-step concussion protocol. The wide receiver will need to be cleared by an independent neurologist to ultimately be cleared for game action. If the 29-year-old cannot recover from the injury by the Steelers' Week 1 showdown with the Falcons, Kaden Wetjen projects to fill the No. 5 wide receiver role.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Quiet during 2025 regular season
metadata.description: Skowronek secured four of six targets for 69 yards and a touchdown while appearing in all 17 regular-season games in 2025.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek had a 22-yard touchdown reception in the Steelers' Week 1 win over the Jets, but his production went downhill from there. He failed to garner multiple targets in any of his regular-season appearances, and he was forced to play mainly on special teams during his fifth professional campaign. The 2021 seventh-rounder will be an unrestricted free agent during the offseason, and it wouldn't be surprising to see him seek out other opportunities after being held under 70 receiving yards in each of his two seasons in Pittsburgh.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Cleared for Sunday
metadata.description: Skowronek (illness/hand) doesn't have an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Similar to last week, Skowronek managed to log a full practice on the final day of the week to be cleared of any injury designation heading into gameday. This marks consecutive weeks that the wide receiver will play through a hand injury. The 28-year-old played just four offensive snaps last week with no targets, making his living on 65 percent of special teams snaps. This week will likely be no different for Skowronek, who sits behind DK Metcalf, Calvin Austin, Adam Thielen, and Marquez Valdes-Scantling on the wide receiver depth chart.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (illness/hand) limited Thursday
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek (illness/hand) was limited at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was once again limited at practice on Thursday as he continues to deal with a hand injury and a minor illness of some kind. It remains to be seen whether or not he will play in Week 16, but his status doesn't carry much weight from a fantasy perspective.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Limited Wednesday
metadata.description: Skowronek (illness/hand) was limited in Wednesday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek dealt with the hand issue last week in practice, but the illness is new for the special-teams standout and wide receiver. Skowronek has posted a career-high 19 tackles (nine solo) in kick coverage for Pittsburgh.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - No injury designation for MNF
metadata.description: Skowronek (hand) was not given an injury designation for Monday's clash against Miami.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek didn't practice Wednesday due to the hand issue, but he was able to finish the week with consecutive limited sessions. Those will be enough for the veteran wideout to take the field against the Dolphins on Monday Night Football. Skowronek has seen most of his work on special teams of late, as he has logged just 13 offensive snaps as opposed to 29 special-teams snaps over the past two weeks.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Limited in practice Friday
metadata.description: Skowronek (hand) was a limited participant in Friday's practice, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was unable to practice Wednesday, so an upgrade in participation level is a good sign for the wide receiver's chances of playing in Monday night's game against the Dolphins. The 28-year-old will have one more opportunity to upgrade to a full participant and avoid an injury designation for Monday's game.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek (hand) sidelined at practice Thursday
metadata.description: Ben Skowronek (hand) was sidelined at Pittsburgh's practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek was one of Pittsburgh's players who were not able to practice on Thursday due to an injury. He doesn't see much work even when fully healthy for the Steelers, however, so his potential absence in Week 15 wouldn't carry much weight for fantasy purposes.

metadata.title: Ben Skowronek - Sits out practice Thursday
metadata.description: Skowronek (hand) did not participate in Thursday's practice, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Skowronek dealt with a shoulder injury during practice Week 14 but managed to suit up for the Steelers' win over Baltimore without any sort of designation. Now, however, the depth wideout's status appears uncertain due to a hand issue. Skowronek will have two more opportunities to get back on the practice field ahead of Monday's matchup against the Dolphins.
